newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-David Jones to sell Adelaide site.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-David Jones to sell Adelaide site.

text.p: Upmarket retailer David Jones Ltd said on Thursday that it planned to sell the John Martin's department store site in Adelaide's Rundle Mall as part of a privately-funded A$300 million redevelopment.
The company said it was expected that the sale of the site would realise a price in excess of the book value.
It said the other two John Martin's stores at Kilkenny and Elizabeth in South Australia would be rebadged as David Jones stores in August this year.
The Rundle Mall redevelopment would be led by Baulderstone Hornibrook, a unit of German construction group Bilfinger and Berger Bau Ag.

"The decision follows an extensive review of the South Australian operations which showed that some of the assets were underperforming in relation to the investment criteria laid down by the David Jones board," David Jones chief executive Chris Tideman said.
"This (Rundle Mall) project has significant benefits for the South Australian public and reflects our policy of continuously monitoring opportunities to increase shareholder value," Tideman said.
